fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-06-16 around 21:05 hrs, it was reported that Tamilarasan Karuppasamy found that the main gate near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony in Tiruppur had been damaged overnight, causing a loss of roughly Rs. 90,000. The complaint was lodged by Jothi Murugan (9000000142) on behalf of Tamilarasan Karuppasamy, whose contact number is given as 9000000425. The complainant alleged that Anand Palanisamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000093. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000363. Padmini Raj (9000000032) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A second person, Anand Muthu (9000000280), was also mentioned as possibly present. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Damage reportedly caused overnight by unidentified persons.
